answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 44377 Country: Bangladesh Title: Islamic Names Muhsin ul Islam Question: Could we name our expected boy Mahsheen-ul-Islam! How is the name and its meaning? We will appreciate your earliest reply. Answer ID: 44377 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 502/502/M=1434) You can keep the name ‘Muhsinul Islam’ for your son. Muhsin means one who does good and kindness with someone. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
